subject: Request: permission to use LumenAI logo & 30s video clip for case study
messages:
From: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>
To: Sanjay Rao <sanjay@lumen.ai>
Cc: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 14 May 2028 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Request: permission to use LumenAI logo & 30s video clip for case study

Hi Sanjay —

Thanks again for the great conversation last week. We put together a short case study draft and a 30-second highlight clip from the product demo that we think would make a useful joint marketing piece. Would LumenAI be open to us publishing the case study on our website and social channels, and using the LumenAI logo alongside Redwood Inference branding?

Quick notes:
- We’ve attached a one-page draft and the trimmed 30s clip (stub).
- We’d like to include a short quote from Priya (already inline in the draft).
- We’ll follow your logo usage rules in the attached guidelines.

If you’re comfortable, could you please:
1) Confirm logo usage approval or send any required brand asset files;
2) Confirm permission to publish the 30s clip and one-paragraph customer quote;
3) Loop in your legal/comms if they need to review a short release.

Attached: redwood-case-study-draft.docx (draft), lumenai-30s-cut.mp4 (stub), logo-guidelines-lumenai.pdf

Thanks — happy to jump on a quick call if helpful.

—Monica
Monica Patel | Enterprise AE | Redwood Inference
(Attachment: redwood-case-study-draft.docx - 92KB)
(Attachment: lumenai-30s-cut.mp4 - 30s clip stub)
(Attachment: logo-guidelines-lumenai.pdf - 210KB)

From: Priya Desai <priya.desai@lumen.ai>
To: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>
Cc: Sanjay Rao <sanjay@lumen.ai>, legal-team@lumen.ai
Date: Mon, 14 May 2028 11:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: permission to use LumenAI logo & 30s video clip for case study

Hi Monica —

Thanks for sending. We like the draft and the highlight clip looks good. I’ve forwarded to our legal/comms team (cc’d) to confirm the standard marketing release. Two quick asks from our side:
1) Please remove the sentence that mentions transaction values (we prefer not to publish numbers);
2) Can you provide the final .svg of the Redwood lockup you’ll use so we can review co-brand spacing?

I’ll aim to get formal sign-off from legal by Wednesday.

—Priya
VP, Product Marketing | LumenAI
(Attachment: none)

From: Legal Intake <legal-team@lumen.ai>
To: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>, Priya Desai <priya.desai@lumen.ai>
Date: Tue, 15 May 2028 09:28:00 -0700
Subject: Fwd: Request: permission to use LumenAI logo & 30s video clip for case study

Hi Monica —

We reviewed the draft. The edits are minimal: please remove the transaction value sentence as Priya requested and add the following release language in the footer: “Customer grants Redwood Inference non-exclusive, worldwide rights to use the Customer name, logo and the supplied short video clip for marketing and promotional purposes for a period of two (2) years.” We don’t need further redlines beyond that.

Also, please send us the final clip file before publishing so we can confirm no internal screenshots appear.

Thanks,
LumenAI Legal Intake (on behalf of LumenAI Legal)
(Attachment: none)

From: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>
To: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>, Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 15 May 2028 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Fwd: LumenAI marketing release — legal language request (please review)

Team —

Forwarding LumenAI legal’s requested footer language and a request to confirm the final copy and assets before sending updated files back to Lumen. They asked for: remove transaction value sentence, add 2-year non-exclusive rights language, and final clip for a quick pre-publish check.

Attachments: redwood-case-study-draft.docx, lumenai-30s-cut.mp4 (stub)

Can Laura or Marissa confirm the proposed release wording is acceptable to Redwood? We prefer to avoid term longer than 2 years unless product marketing wants evergreen rights.

—Monica

From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
To: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>, Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 16 May 2028 08:46:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Fwd: LumenAI marketing release — legal language request (please review)

Monica —

Thanks for circulating. The proposed two-year, non-exclusive limited release is fine. Please accept their footer language as-is and do not change the timeframe. We should, however, add a clause that Redwood will not alter any of LumenAI’s product UI imagery without explicit approval. Add: "Redwood will not modify or crop Customer-provided UI screenshots or video in a manner that changes meaning without Customer approval."

Once you incorporate those two items (remove numbers + added UI clause), send back the redline and the final clip for clearance.

—Laura
Senior Counsel | Redwood Inference

From: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>
To: Sanjay Rao <sanjay@lumen.ai>, Priya Desai <priya.desai@lumen.ai>, legal-team@lumen.ai
Cc: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 17 May 2028 11:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: permission to use LumenAI logo & 30s video clip for case study — final

Hi Priya / Sanjay —

Thanks for the quick turn. Attached is the updated one-page case study (numbers removed) and the final 30-second clip (we removed the one internal screen capture you flagged). We’ve also included the release wording in the footer and added the UI protection clause per Laura’s note.

If the legal team can confirm the wording below is acceptable, we’ll schedule the publish for next Tuesday and send over the final web assets (SVGs and web-optimized video).

Release wording included in footer: "Customer grants Redwood Inference non-exclusive, worldwide rights to use the Customer name, logo and the supplied short video clip for marketing and promotional purposes for a period of two (2) years. Redwood will not modify or crop Customer-provided UI screenshots or video in a manner that changes meaning without Customer approval."

Attachments: redwood-case-study-final.docx (updated), lumenai-30s-cut-final.mp4 (stub), redwood-lockup.svg (for review)

—Monica
Enterprise AE | Redwood Inference
